verdict.rationale: Lago's own plan-model docs show some billing-cycle control: a yearly interval where subscription fees bill annually and charges can bill monthly or annually, with invoices generated per the plan model. None of the anchor-specific elements of the story are evidenced. missing for 10: calendar vs anniversary billing choice, alignment of billing dates across a customer's subscriptions, custom invoice/anchor dates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can control billing anchors and cycles — calendar vs anniversary billing, alignment across a customer's subscriptions, custom invoice dates

citations.quote: Yearly: subscription fees are billed on a yearly basis and charges can be billed monthly or annually.
Lago automatically generates invoices for each customer according to the plan model.
